description: A ten by ten patch matrix holding sixteen scenes, a clock stepping through whole sets of connections.

params.text: Sets how many scenes the sequence steps through, 1 to 16.
Advances to the next scene by hand.
Moves the editing scene on by one, cycling through all sixteen whatever the step count is set to.
Moves the editing scene back by one, cycling through all sixteen whatever the step count is set to.
Connects that input jack to that output jack; a green light marks the connection in the scene being edited and a red light marks it in the scene playing now.

inputs.text: A trigger advances to the next scene, returning to scene 1 after the last one.
A signal fed into the matrix, reaching whichever output jacks are connected to it in the active scene.
A trigger randomises the matrix, following the randomisation choices on the menu.
A trigger returns the sequence to scene 1.

outputs.text: The sum of every input connected to it in the active scene.

notes: every connection in all sixteen scenes starts switched off, so nothing reaches any output until matrix buttons are pressed or the matrix is randomised.
menu: Only Randomize Active Connections — limits randomisation to rows with a cable in the input jack and columns with a cable in the output jack.
Which Step to Randomize — Edit step randomises the scene being edited, Active step the scene playing now, and All steps all sixteen.
Output Row Randomization Method — sets how many inputs randomisation gives an output: One or none, Exactly one, Zero or more, or One or more.
Output Polyphony — sets how many channels every output carries, 1 to 16, or Automatic.
